frameddrawer.use:
How 2 Change Texture: 
Inside a crafting window place the block you
want use the texture of for the outside of
the drawer in the first slot of the crafting
window, on the second slot put the block that
will be used for the texture on the inside of
the framed drawer and on the third slot put a
framed drawer. You can change the drawer
divider texture by adding a block into the 4th
slot

config.functionalstorage.title: Functional Storage Settings
config.functionalstorage.rejoin: Some changes take effect after you rejoin the world
config.functionalstorage.server: Set by the server you are connected to
config.functionalstorage.render.drawer_r: Distance, in blocks, within which drawers render their contents. Block entities stop rendering past 64.
Thickness of the 3D item and block displays on drawer fronts.
config.functionalstorage.controller.link: Radius, in blocks, around a Storage Controller in which drawers can be linked, before upgrades.
config.functionalstorage.controller.rang:
Storage upgrades inside a controller extend its reach instead of a capacity.
Reach = linking_range + the product of (upgrade multiplier / range_divisor, rounded down) over all upgrades.
With the defaults one Netherite Upgrade gives 8 + 32 = 40 blocks.
config.functionalstorage.storage.drawer_:
Base capacity of a 1x1 drawer slot, counted in stacks of 64 items (32 = 2048 items).
Fluid drawers of the same size hold this many buckets per slot. Ender Drawers are based on this value too.
Base capacity of each slot of a 1x2 drawer, counted in stacks of 64 items (buckets for fluid drawers).
Base capacity of each slot of a 2x2 drawer, counted in stacks of 64 items (buckets for fluid drawers).
config.functionalstorage.storage.compact: Base capacity of a Compacting Drawer, in stacks of its most compacted item (8 stacks = 512 iron blocks).
config.functionalstorage.storage.simple_: Base capacity of a Simple Compacting Drawer, in stacks of its most compacted item.
config.functionalstorage.storage.ender_d: An Ender Drawer holds this many times the base capacity of a 1x1 drawer. Storage upgrades do not apply.
config.functionalstorage.storage.denied_:
Items that cannot be stored in drawers, compacting drawers or through a controller,
in addition to the functionalstorage:drawer_storage_denylist item tag.
Fluids that cannot be stored in fluid drawers, in addition to the functionalstorage:fluid_drawer_storage_denylist fluid tag.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.copper: Capacity multiplier of the Copper Upgrade. Several upgrades in one drawer multiply together.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.gold_m: Capacity multiplier of the Gold Upgrade.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.diamon: Capacity multiplier of the Diamond Upgrade.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.nether: Capacity multiplier of the Netherite Upgrade.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.fluid_: Fluid drawers divide every storage upgrade multiplier by this (rounded down, never below 1).
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.creati:
Upgrades that cannot share a drawer's storage upgrade slots with the Creative Vending Upgrade,
in addition to the functionalstorage:creative_vending_upgrade_incompatible item tag.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.tick_i: How often, in ticks, the Pulling, Pushing and Collector upgrades run (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.pullin: Items a Pulling Upgrade moves each time it runs.

Fluid, in millibuckets, a Pulling Upgrade moves into a fluid drawer each time it runs.
If that moves nothing because the other side only gives whole buckets (a lava cauldron), one bucket is moved.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.pushin: Items a Pushing Upgrade moves each time it runs.

Fluid, in millibuckets, a Pushing Upgrade moves out of a fluid drawer each time it runs.
If that moves nothing because the other side only takes whole buckets (a lava cauldron), one bucket is moved.
config.functionalstorage.upgrades.collec: Items a Collector Upgrade takes from each dropped item entity each time it runs.
config.functionalstorage.armory.cabinet_: Number of slots in an Armory Cabinet. Lowering it deletes whatever is stored in the removed slots.
config.functionalstorage.armory.insertab:
Items the Armory Cabinet accepts even if they would not pass its usual checks (stackable items, for example),
in addition to the functionalstorage:armory_cabinet_insertable item tag.
